news.title: Fani Willis claims she was targeted by fraudulent voter registration in New York
news.summary: Fulton County DA Fani Willis reports she was targeted by a fraudulent voter registration filed in her name in New York.

news.title: Gwinnett County Police debut Drone First Responder program at 2 precincts
news.summary: Gwinnett County police launched a new Drone First Responder program at two precincts to cut down response times.

news.title: Duluth officer realized an erratic driver needed sugar, not handcuffs
news.summary: A Duluth officer who pulled over a swerving SUV expecting a drunk driver instead found a man on his way home from dialysis with his blood sugar crashing, body camera video shows.

news.title: Gwinnett police drones can now reach emergencies before officers do
news.summary: Gwinnett County police started flying drones to some emergency calls Thursday, and they say the cameras will often reach a scene before the first officer gets there.

news.title: Fourth suspect wanted for murder in custody after SWAT standoff in Johns Creek neighborhood
news.summary: NewsChopper 2 flew over the scene on Nesbitt Ferry Road, where there were multiple SWAT vehicles and officers outside a home.

news.title: GBI identifies suspect shot by Woodstock police in retention pond
news.summary: A suspicious-person call near Paden and Maple streets led police to a retention pond in downtown Woodstock Thursday evening.

news.title: Woman sentenced for cruelty to animals after dog abuse video circulates online
news.summary: A Brookhaven woman who was arrested and charged after a dog abuse video circulated online earlier this year was sentenced Friday.

news.title: Roswell man shot by police after threatening to shoot people, authorities say
news.summary: Woodstock police shot a man in a retention pond after he threatened to shoot others. The suspect is in stable condition.

news.title: ‘Friend to many:’ Decatur police mourn loss of officer
news.summary: A metro Atlanta police department is mourning the loss of an officer remembered for his friendship, dedication and service to the community.

news.title: DHS officer indicted after allegedly shooting Decatur neighbor following noise argument, DA says
news.summary: Quadrus Wilson, 49, faces multiple charges including aggravated assault and false imprisonment after the July incident in DeKalb County.

news.summary: A driver fled a Cobb County police traffic stop Thursday night before crashing in Atlanta and running from the scene, authorities said.

news.summary: Regan Wheeler, a devoutly religious man, was shot in his driveway on Oct. 13, 2005. DNA testing is underway on the shell casings found at the crime scene.

news.title: FBI offering reward of up to $20K for information after Molotov cocktail thrown at Atlanta ICE office
news.summary: The day after the arson attempt happened, the FBI released photos of the person they were looking for in connection with the crime.
